searchText: Once the light client protocols are standardized, you can expect every beacon API provider to make them available (default on / opt-out). The current REST endpoints are being discussed here: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/181 A lot of progress towards standardization of consensus light client protocols has been made during Devconnect AMS. Summaries of technical discussions during the week can be found in the comments at the bottom of https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2802#issuecomment-1107474871 <@881905303011086387> thanks for the clarification!

excerpts.content:
Once the light client protocols are standardized, you can expect every beacon API provider to make them available (default on / opt-out).
The current REST endpoints are being discussed here: https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/181

excerpts.author: etan_status
excerpts.content:
A lot of progress towards standardization of consensus light client protocols has been made during Devconnect AMS.
Summaries of technical discussions during the week can be found in the comments at the bottom of https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/2802#issuecomment-1107474871
